notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Wing IDE 5, 25% off!
notes.notes:
Wing IDE 5 is Now Available on Steam and is 25% off!*

Wing IDE is an integrated development environment for the Python programming language. Its powerful editor and debugger speed up development of Python code for Autodesk Maya, NUKE, Blender, Source Filmmaker, and other Python-based applications and libraries.

*Offer ends May 7 at 10AM Pacific Time
